new_panels.image_credit: Kentec Man-1093, Issue 06, May 2016, PDF page 5; unchanged manufacturer figure
new_panels.identification_notes: Manufacturer fascia illustration of the mains-powered eight-zone repeater. Shared enclosure appearance does not identify two/four/eight zones or mains/24V supply.
new_panels.applicability_limits: Repeater family, not the Sigma CP main control panel. Man-1093 Issue 06 covers the six listed K/E variants. Check the complete label and revision; page 3 restricts compatibility to main-panel PCB part numbers with an alpha suffix.

new_panels.image_credit: Kentec Man-1132, Issue 03, June 2013, PDF page 5; unchanged manufacturer figure
new_panels.identification_notes: Manufacturer fascia illustration for the mains-powered HydroSense water-detection repeater, with Alarm and water-detection labels.
new_panels.applicability_limits: Water-detection repeater, not a fire control panel or the HydroSense CP main panel. Man-1132 B3420 Issue 03 covers mains/24V variants; confirm the exact label and supply. Included alongside the existing HydroSense entries in the Kentec archive pack.

new_panels.image_credit: Kentec Man-1052, Issue 02, November 1998, PDF page 1; unchanged manufacturer figure
new_panels.identification_notes: Manufacturer manual cover photograph: pale moulded enclosure, central LCD/control strip and Solo badge.
new_panels.applicability_limits: Historical Solo Response repeater, not a Solo main panel or Solo 2 Response. Man-1052 Issue 02 describes a single-loop analogue-addressable repeater; verify the installed label, fitted options and applicable revision.

new_panels.image_credit: Kentec Man-1064, Issue 01, July 2002, PDF page 1; unchanged manufacturer figure
new_panels.identification_notes: Manufacturer manual cover photograph: metal cabinet, horizontal zone indicators above the display, round controls and right-side key lock.
new_panels.applicability_limits: Historical Solo 2 Response repeater, not the Solo 2 main panel or earlier Solo Response. Man-1064 Issue 01 is retained with its actual edition; appearance does not establish firmware or optional facilities.

manual_links.scope_note: Checked user guide DFU7001020 Rev 2 is a family manual for CFP Standard, Economy and AlarmSense. Its page 3 feature chart distinguishes them; some sections do not apply to every variant. Match the panel label.
Checked Standard installation/maintenance manual DFU7004010 Rev 1 is linked separately. It must not be used as the AlarmSense or Economy engineering manual.
Checked historical XFP user guide DFU2000501 Rev 2 shows both single-loop 16-zone and one/two-loop 32-zone layouts on page 6. It is not a CAST user guide; check the installed protocol and revision.
Checked CAST user guide DFU5020000 Rev 3 covers XFP501E/CA, XFP501/CA and XFP502/CA as listed on its cover. Do not substitute it for Apollo/Hochiki XFP variants.
Checked CAST ZFP user guide DFU5030050 Rev 3 (1 May 2022) covers the cabinet ranges on its cover. This is the CAST family edition, not the ZFP Apollo manual.
Checked EACIE user guide DFU5030070 Rev 1 covers 1–4-loop evacuation alert equipment and states it is for Fire and Rescue Service use. It is not an ordinary fire-alarm user guide.
Checked Syncro multi-loop user manual Man-1057 Issue 09 (June 2013) is linked as a historical edition. Do not assume it applies to Syncro AS, Lite, XT or every firmware revision.
